text:
alex_sales: Kicking off Novabank POC thread. Need final scope on SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, domain verification, and committed Dedicated pricing. Goal: handoff to eng by EOD after paperwork.

maria_se: Can someone confirm whether Novabank expects IdP-initiated or SP-initiated SSO? Also need IdP metadata and preferred nameID format (email vs persistent).

emily_novabank: We prefer SP-initiated for now. We'll send metadata URL and sample user schema. NameID = email.

jordan_ts: Noted. For SCIM: do you expect provisioning via Bearer token or mTLS? If Bearer, what's the rotation cadence? Also confirm attribute for externalId (we prefer `externalId`).

emily_novabank: Bearer token is fine for the POC; rotation every 90 days is acceptable. We'll use `externalId` and `employeeType` as a custom attribute for role hints.

sam_security: Security input: 1) We recommend mTLS for production; POC token ok. 2) Audit log retention default 90 days; enterprise option 365 days. 3) SAML cert rotation process documented, need to add to SOW. 4) If they want org-level domain verification across multiple domains, plan for ~3-business-day validation per domain.

maria_se: For mapping groups->roles during POC, we'll use a small transform: groups array -> RBAC role mapping. Example SCIM payload we'll use to test provisioning: 
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
  "Resources": [
    {
      "id": "user-987",
      "userName": "t.smith@novabank.com",
      "externalId": "novabank|987",
      "emails": [{"value": "t.smith@novabank.com"}],
      "groups": ["payments","risk"]
    }
  ]
}
```
We'll map payments->payments-analyst, risk->risk-viewer. Set SCIM rate-limit for initial sync to 50 req/min.

alex_sales: Pricing ask: they want a committed Dedicated estimate for 120 req/s sustained, ~1.2M tokens/day, monthly reserved + overage. Also include enterprise support and extended logging. Jordan, can you prepare a line-item estimate and call out caveats for quantized models / throughput tuning?

jordan_ts: On it. I'll prepare the estimate and include: reserved monthly price (GPU pool), overage per 1K tokens, 24/7 support add-on, 90->365d audit log pricing, and a note that tight latency SLOs may require higher commit.

emily_novabank: Legal requires an SSO/SCIM clause in the SOW before budget approval. Can you share a short template? Also confirm data residency: we need EU region for production.

legal_bot: SOW template (short) available in /templates/sow/identity-sow-template.md. Key SSO clauses: cert rotation, metadata exchange, termination of provisioning, data residency note.

sam_security: I'll draft a minimal SOW clause and fill the security questionnaire. Reminder: if they require per-route RBAC with tenant isolation and per-route logging, that increases implementation scope (and cost) vs basic org-level RBAC.

maria_se: Implementation plan for POC: 1) Receive IdP metadata and SCIM token from Novabank. 2) Configure SP-initiated SAML in staging. 3) Configure SCIM with group->role mapping and test provisioning. 4) Validate domain ownership via DNS TXT for their primary domain. 5) Run load test with prefix/KV cache and measure latency.

alex_sales: Ops ask: ensure Dedicated pool config has capacity headroom for load tests. Also include fallback model variants for graceful degradation. Jordan + Maria to sync with eng-releases.

jordan_ts: I'll sync with eng and draft a handoff checklist for the implementation team (metadata, SCIM token, role mappings, domain DNS TXT entries, data residency region).

emily_novabank: We'll send metadata, SCIM sample, and domain owners list by EOD. Can we get the SOW clause and pricing estimate within 24h?

sam_security: Yes for SOW clause and security QA within 24h. Note: if Novabank opts into mTLS for SCIM or 365d logs, onboarding timeline and cost will change.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/enterprise-poc-config -> staging at 2024-10-13T02:00Z :rocket:

alex_sales: Thanks everyone. Next check-in in 24h. :thumbsup:
